purpose: Teach: 投げかけ/飼料/熟練/義務付け/ステンレス/預かり/行き過ぎ/混在

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、市民に、問いを、投げかける形で、防犯意識、高めてまいります、御社にも、ご協力、お願いします。
lines.en: We're going to raise public crime awareness by putting this case to citizens as a series of questions. We'd appreciate your company's cooperation.
lines.style: Measured and official, but not rigid. Speaking from procedural experience. Even pacing, steady eye contact. Professional courtesy in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件関連、ペット飼料の流通、調べる必要、出てきております、警察、本格化中ですよね、現在。
lines.en: Yes. We've found we need to investigate the distribution channels for pet feed related to this case. The police are really ramping up their efforts right now.
lines.style: Attentive, collaborative. Slightly careful phrasing—acknowledging the seriousness while staying grounded. Even delivery, no rush. Leaning in slightly to show engagement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 熟練の捜査官、若手の育成にも、力を、注いでおります、警察、本当に、人材育成、徹底中です、最近。
lines.en: We're investing in developing our junior investigators as well—we have skilled detectives training the next generation. Talent development is a priority for us at the moment.
lines.style: Steady, explanatory. Taking care to show institutional commitment. No urgency, but quiet conviction underneath. Speaking from a position of quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。防犯機器の設置、警察様から、義務付けられているわけではないですが、当社、自主的に、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. Installing security equipment isn't something the police have mandated, but we've decided to move forward with it on our own initiative.
lines.style: Slightly formal but genuine. Not defensive—matter-of-fact about the decision. Measured pace. A subtle note of responsibility in the tone, not burden.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 凶器、ステンレス製、確認されました、本件、捜査、本格化中です、警察、総力を、挙げております、現在。
lines.en: The weapon has been confirmed to be stainless steel. The investigation is entering a serious phase now. The police are mobilizing all available resources.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate delivery. Treating the information as significant without dramatizing it. Steady breathing. Slight pause before important nouns. Professional weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、預かり物、警察様の指示通り、保管しております、捜査、ご協力、いたします、本当に、全力で。
lines.en: Yes. We're storing any items we found on the premises according to police instructions. We're ready to fully cooperate with the investigation.
lines.style: Firm and sincere. No hedging. Direct eye contact. Speaking from genuine willingness to help, not obligation. Calm, steady pace throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、行き過ぎた行動、何度も、犯していますね、過去にも、社会的影響、本当に、大きいです、本件、特に。
lines.en: The suspect has shown a pattern of escalating behavior over time. Previous incidents have had significant social impact, and this case is particularly concerning.
lines.style: Grave but controlled. Speaking from accumulated case knowledge. Slight weight on key phrases without raising volume. Measured, almost quiet—the gravity comes from the content, not delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、外部関係者と、混在する状況、ある時間帯、警察、注意、いただきたいです、本当に、警備、ご相談したい。
lines.en: Yes. During certain time periods, we have both employees and external visitors on the premises at the same time. I'd like to ask the police to pay special attention to that. We're hoping to consult with you about security measures.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful. Not alarmed, but plainly concerned about a concrete vulnerability. Speaking slowly enough for the officer to follow. Genuine request for partnership at the end—slight softening of tone.
